signal_rule.description: For each team + dimension value, use only seasons before the held-out test season. A historical directional signal exists only when at least 8 market-resolved training games are available and the training ATS win rate or O/U over rate is >=58% or <=42%. The held-out season never chooses the direction or threshold.

guardrails: No held-out result may select a team trend direction, threshold, category, or sample-size rule.
Each 2024 test uses only 2021-2023 history; each 2025 test uses only 2021-2024 history.
Opponent .500 status must remain pregame-only exactly as defined by Step 4.
Missing historical spread or total is unknown and excluded from that market test.
A research candidate is not a betting recommendation, model weight, projection adjustment, or production promotion.
No category receives production authority from Step 5 regardless of backtest result.
Do not combine multiple dimensions into mined conjunctions in this step.
Step 4 descriptive database and Step 6.5E sportsbook-free football calibration must remain logically separate.
next_step: Match only backtested trend categories to current-game conditions as contextual evidence, still without automatic betting authority.
